useCaseSummary:
Casper – Consumer Goods Cloud project







Himanshu Dixit









Introduction

Casper's field sales team relied on rigid, checklist-based tools within Consumer Goods Cloud for store visits. The standard Action Plan Templates limited data capture to simple true/false toggles and could not handle the complex, variable data required for mattress inventory tracking. This resulted in incomplete data, a poor user experience for field reps, and a lack of granular insights into in-store product placement.

This project transformed the retail execution process by leveraging the flexibility of Salesforce Screen Flows and custom Lightning Web Components (LWC). We replaced the static template with a dynamic, guided mobile experience that captures rich, structured data—including detailed mattress counts—directly in the store. This delivers superior visit quality data, empowers reps, and provides the business with unprecedented visibility into both per-visit execution and long-term store performance.

title: Custom LWC Excel-Style Interface for Education Data Management

The complexity of pulling data from multiple objects created confusion and reduced productivity. Streamlined workflows and increased efficiency for end users working with complex data relationships.

Streamlined file management processes with intuitive interface and proper access controls.

challenge: Employees lacked a centralized platform to manage tasks, track leave, and stay informed about team activities. Task management was fragmented across different tools. Leave management required manual coordination and team members were often unaware of colleagues' leave schedules. No visibility into upcoming company events, leading to scheduling conflicts and missed opportunities for team engagement.
solution: Developed a standalone web application company portal for employees. Created a Jira-like interface for comprehensive task management, enabling teams to track projects, assign tasks, and monitor progress. Implemented leave management system allowing employees to request leave and automatically notify team members when someone is on leave. Built event management functionality to display upcoming company events, ensuring better team coordination and engagement.
results: Centralized task management improved team productivity and project visibility. Automated leave notifications eliminated scheduling conflicts and improved team coordination. Enhanced team awareness with real-time visibility into leave schedules and upcoming events. Streamlined employee experience with a single portal for task management, leave tracking, and event information. Improved organizational efficiency through better communication and coordination.
